fontFamily: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, JetBrains Mono, monospace

themeVariables.fontFamily: JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, JetBrains Mono, monospace

themeCSS: text, tspan { white-space: pre; } .edgeLabel rect.background { fill: #ffffff; opacity: 1; } .edgeLabel text { fill: #57606a; } .cluster-label tspan { font-weight: bold; } .cluster.virtual > rect { fill: none; stroke: #57606a; stroke-dasharray: 6 4; } .cluster.nested > rect { fill: #eaeef2; } .node rect, .cluster > rect { rx: 6px; ry: 6px; }
